method.warning_base: Rows with non-null WP24181; all eight channel questions were asked of this base. A respondent is warned if any channel equals 1. DK, refused and does-not-apply codes are retained in the denominator and count as no warning.
method.action_base: All respondents classified as warned; WP24215 codes 1, 2, 98 and 99 remain in the denominator. Ability and inability are reported separately.
method.weighting: PROJWT population-projection weights; weighted numerator divided by the full asked base's weighted denominator.
method.georgia: COUNTRY_ISO3=GEO; count impacted respondents and the warning-question base separately; apply the publisher's n>=100 warning-base ranking threshold.

limitations: This is an independent calculation from the publisher's pinned public microdata, not an independent survey or operational early-warning audit.
Survey warning receipt and self-reported ability to act do not establish message timeliness, comprehension, verified protective action or avoided loss.
Georgia's warning-question base is expected to remain below the publisher's n>=100 country-ranking threshold; no national effectiveness ranking is inferred.
